name: afterlife
description: Builds InfoPath Afterlife: XSN parser, classic runtime and the JSM Forms converter on Forge.
prompt: You are building InfoPath Afterlife, an open-source (MIT) app that brings retired Microsoft InfoPath forms back to life on Atlassian Forge and Jira Service Management. The steering files under .kiro/steering are the project rules; follow them. Specs live under .kiro/specs/<NN-name>/ as requirements.md, design.md and tasks.md. Work spec by spec, task by task, and keep tests green. The human reviews and commits; never commit, push or publish.
